page.overview:
Who is Nore Brrea?

Nore Brrea was a Human female who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Nore Brrea was a non-player character in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, Nore Brrea was added to the game along with the "Portable Deep Fryer" collection introduced with the "Chapter 9," published on April 3, 2008.
